public_mouths.name: SaturationMonoid.PhysicsCore.Stage10.Bell.reported_probability_closed_form
public_mouths.type:
∀ (first second : SaturationMonoid.PhysicsCore.Stage10.Bell.BinaryReadoutChannel) (plus : Bool)
  (a b : SaturationMonoid.PhysicsCore.Stage10.Bell.Axis) (u v : Bool),
  SaturationMonoid.PhysicsCore.Stage10.Bell.reportedProbability first second plus a b u v =
    ((1 + SaturationMonoid.PhysicsCore.Stage10.Bell.sign u * first.bias) *
          (1 + SaturationMonoid.PhysicsCore.Stage10.Bell.sign v * second.bias) +
        SaturationMonoid.PhysicsCore.Stage10.Bell.sign u * SaturationMonoid.PhysicsCore.Stage10.Bell.sign v *
              first.gain *
            second.gain *
          SaturationMonoid.PhysicsCore.Stage10.Bell.latentCorrelation plus a b) /
      4
